judgments.justification: "improved average ROUGE-L... gains of 2.33, 1.60, and 1.51" for GKD, KLD, SRKL; omitted losses not mentioned but core finding correct.
Says "improved scores on most individual datasets", understating that all five improved for every loss.
Outperformed teacher on VicunaEval and S-NI, "but not on the other three or on average (22.94 vs 23.44)".
Does not state full Method M is best on every set among ablations.
Curriculum-only variant (w/o temp. & ratio) is not discussed.
Claims "supervised-ratio schedule is the main driver"; data show temperature is the main driver, and variant descriptions are reversed.
"No statistical tests or standard deviations are reported... limited to the GPT-2 family"; run count and OPT omission not mentioned but limitation conveyed.
"improved average ROUGE-L... gains of 2.33, 1.60, and 1.51 points" for the three losses.
"improvement was consistent on every individual dataset for each loss"; gains listed with GKD largest.
No comparison with the teacher is given.
"full Method M... yields the highest scores on all five datasets".
Says curriculum-only "performs comparably to plain KLD on average", not that it was lower on four of five sets and not consistently improving.
Says removing ratio schedule reduces performance on four of five; actually it improved all five over KLD.
"limited to the GPT-2 family... no statistical significance tests were reported".
